en.headline: Three-vehicle crash on Kwai Chung Road injures at least nine including pregnant woman
en.dek: Police said a light goods vehicle, a medium goods vehicle and a green minibus collided near Yam Hop Hing Industrial Building shortly after 9.11am; the injured were treated and taken to hospital while lanes were closed.
body: Police said they received a report at about 9.11am on Tuesday of a three-vehicle collision on Kwai Chung Road towards Kowloon near Yam Hop Hing Industrial Building.

The vehicles involved were a light goods vehicle, a medium goods vehicle and a green public light bus. At least nine people, including three men and six women among them a pregnant woman, sustained minor injuries. Emergency crews treated them at the scene before taking them to hospital.

According to police accounts reported by local outlets, the light and medium goods vehicles had slowed for traffic when the minibus was suspected to have failed to stop in time and struck the rear of the medium goods vehicle, which then hit the light goods vehicle ahead. The minibus front was heavily damaged and its windscreen shattered.

The Transport Department said some lanes on Kwai Chung Road towards Kowloon near the Cheung Wing Road roundabout were closed, with traffic heavy on the remaining lanes. Police are investigating the cause of the collision.

zh.headline: 葵涌道三車相撞至少九人受傷包括孕婦
zh.dek: 警方表示上午約9時11分接報，輕型貨車、中型貨車及綠色專線小巴在任合興工業大廈對開相撞，傷者送院，部分行車線封閉。
body: 警方表示，周二上午約9時11分接獲報案，指葵涌道往九龍方向、任合興工業大廈對開發生三車相撞。
涉事車輛包括一輛輕型貨車、一輛中型貨車及一輛綠色專線小巴。至少九人受輕傷，包括三男六女，當中有一名孕婦。救援人員在場治理後將傷者送院。
據警方初步說法，輕貨及中貨因應交通收慢時，小巴懷疑收掣不及撞向中型貨車車尾，中貨再撞向前方輕貨。現場小巴車頭嚴重損毀、擋風玻璃碎裂。
運輸署指葵涌道往九龍方向近昌榮路迴旋處部分行車線封閉，餘下行車線交通繁忙。警方正調查意外成因。
